name: lumipymcp
description: AI-agent access to PicoQuant Luminosa microscope systems via LumiPy Python scripting.
long_description: LumiPyMCP lets an AI agent (e.g. Claude Desktop) control and query a PicoQuant Luminosa microscope through the LumiPy Python interface: running measurements, adjusting parameters, and reading back live results. All AI-generated code is logged and saved as an editable Python script for full transparency and reproducibility. Requires a separate PicoQuant Luminosa system running the lumipy_rce_server.py remote execution server. Read the Disclaimer before use: this tool can execute arbitrary AI-generated code against connected microscope hardware.
